evidence_summary: REST POST /v2/vectordb/entities/search with groupParams.groupByField="vector" (a vector field) was accepted twice with http=200 code=0 and 5 results plus topks (REQ5/REQ10), while the gRPC path (raw_observation) rejected group_by=vector with a misleading MilvusException code=1100 'metric type not match: expected=COSINE, actual=L2'.
rationale: Semantic match to the Type1 illegal-success pattern: explicit contract milvus_state_group_by_field_001 (evidence_tier=explicit, grouping-search.md) requires group_by_field to be a scalar field, yet the REST endpoint silently accepted grouping by the vector field and returned success — a clear contract violation reproduced deterministically twice in one log (REQ5 and REQ10), so the single-script forced-not_defect rule does not apply.
